messages.subject: Re: forrtl: severe (161): Program Exception - array bounds
parts:
Sounds like the sort of thing that should not happen - please can you
send me a copy of your Distance project (use File | Export project, and
then save as type *.zip to make a zip file; then use something like
www.yousendit.com to send it to me, as our university anti-virus system
strips zip files when they are attached to emails). I'll take a look at
it. - Len

On 10/08/2010 14:47, Maria wrote:
> > Hello,
> >
> > I ran an analysis using the CDS engine of Distance 6.0 (release 2). The log tab turned red and the following error message was displayed:
> >
> > ** Warning: Analysis engine wrote some output to the console error stream, reproduced below. **
> > -- Start of Console Error Stream --
> > forrtl: severe (161): Program Exception - array bounds exceeded
> >
> > Image PC Routine Line Source
> > MCDS.exe 0042E61D RDFLAT 1063 Datcom.for
> >
> > -- End of Console Error Stream --
> > Analysis engine status 'Run failed - analysis engine encountered an unknown error, possibly in the input or output files'
> > Reading Results
> > Run finished
> >
> >
> > What does this message mean and what went wrong in my analysis? Help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
> >
> > Regards,
> > Maria

messages.author: 311773cbbaaf70b0
messages.subject: Re: forrtl: severe (161): Program Exception - array bounds
parts:
Hello Len,

Thank you for your reply. I was not able to export my project as a zip fi=
le, and Distance said this was because there was an internal error:

Permission denied

(Error raised from: Distance.ClsProject.ExportProjectToZip)
(Error source: Distance)
(Error number: 70)

Distance did not manage to recover from the error so I manually closed th=
e program. I then reopened it and went to 'Compact Project' under 'Tools'=
, and encountered another internal error:

Could not compact database because the following error occured:
'Internal Error number: 53. Internal Error description: "File not found".=
'

(Error raised from: Distance.ClsProject.CompactProject)
(Error source: D6DbEng.ProjectDatabase.CompactJetDatabase)
(Error number: -2147214250)

Please advise.

Maria
